note: BBVA Argentina's card interest rates (in force October 2026): its Visa Internacional's financing rate is a nominal 66.67% a year in pesos. The central bank's transparency register (information of 9 October 2026) gives the card's maximum monthly administration and maintenance fee as 30,000 pesos, at list price, and no renewal fee. Banco de la Nación Argentina, whose account the game keeps, gives the register only an effective rate, not the nominal one this game writes.
